title: Allotment of Code to United Stock Exchange of India Limited
text: DEPUTY GENERAL MANAGER MARKET REGULATION DEPARTMENT MRD/DSA/SE/Cir-8/2010 April 1, 2010 The Managing Directors / Chief Executive Officers/ Officiating Executive Directors of all the Stock Exchanges. Dear Sir/Madam, Allotment of Code to United Stock Exchange of India Limited 1. As you are aware, SEBI has recently granted recognition to United Stock Exchange of India Limited (USEIL). In this regard, USEIL has been allotted Code No. 27. 2. For the purposes of trading and settlement operations, you are advised to inform the trading/clearing members of your Stock Exchange accordingly. Yours faithfully, RAJESH KUMAR D -- 1 of 1 --
